title: New Amex bonus: 10% to Avianca LifeMiles
message: Avianca LifeMiles: 10% bonus, 1,000 Amex points become 1,100 LifeMiles, Nov 16 through Dec 16, 2026. Not reported as targeted; sources mention no registration (the offer shows on the Amex transfer page). Min transfer 1,000 points, max 750,000.
